title: Stranded in Indianapolis
summary: The show's owner and comedian Eddie Green leave with the money and the cast is stranded, his first strand.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well, when I got this show, I had to reorganize the band. The only one I had with me when I reorganized the band was the drummer. The rest of them had left. Now, here's what happened. We take the show out, and for the first time, I was stranded. This was my first strand. We got as far as Indianapolis. And Eddy Green was on this show. He was one of our first-class comedians. He and the man that owned the show, was called Friedenwald, that's 'free forest', Friedenwald.
Anyhow, he -- they both left and from Indianapolis, went on to Chicago, and took what money. We were stranded out there.
Well, now, there was another fellow there named Gus Smith. Gus Smith knew what to do. I didn't know that to do.

So he said, 'Well we can't leave all our girls out here stranded, like this.' And they were perfectly at home, that's one thing. I know one girl just got a newspaper and covered her head up and laid her head up on the wardrobe, and went right on to sleep.

We was all in the station, waiting. We was supposed to move on to another town. But there wasn't nobody there to move us on to the other town. That was the first strand. I didn't realize that I was stranded. I didn't even know what it meant.
